verdict.rationale: Parahelp documents its own gap-identification capability. Users can prompt the Internal Agent for a report on where the Customer Agent falls short, and automations can watch tools and the support queue to surface gaps on their own. The docs do not say these gaps are knowledge-specific, and nothing covers detecting conflicting or contradictory content. Missing for 10: explicit knowledge-gap detection tied to missed or fumbled questions, conflicting-content detection, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a support ops lead, the platform surfaces knowledge gaps and conflicting content that cause the agent to miss or fumble questions

citations.quote: Set up automations that watch your tools and your support queue and surface gaps on their own.
Prompt the Internal Agent for a report on how your Customer Agent is performing and where it falls short.
